Finley: adapting explanations · expanded view

Finley likes noticing where another student gets stuck and finding a different example. Tutoring a younger pupil was more enjoyable than doing a task for them. Finley likes science and language subjects, is willing to study education, and wants a steady life with time for friends rather than a very high income goal.

Narrative model, with its answers frozen before the first run. Optional questions omitted by the shorter route are marked. These are synthetic checks, not observations of students.

Authored model & first-run review

Helps at a supervised homework club and has tried two explanations for the same maths idea. No professional teaching experience.

Peer tutoring does not establish teaching ability, classroom-management skill or licensing eligibility.
